name: Vyoma UI
summary: React component library built on shadcn/ui with animated components, AI chat inputs, text animations and Three.js backgrounds.
description: Vyoma UI (VUI) is a React component library for Next.js built on top of shadcn/ui, with 30+ copy-paste components: buttons, cards, forms, bento grids, sheets, tooltips, text animations, animated backgrounds and AI chat pieces. Styled with Tailwind CSS and animated with Framer Motion and GSAP; MIT licensed.
contains: 30+ React components on top of shadcn/ui
AI components: chat and magical chat input
text animations: animated number, blur, typing, waving, decryption
